exams.name: Tradesman oral or written examination
exams.notes: Required to determine general knowledge of the trade. Exemptions exist for those previously certified by the Board of Housing and Community Development, local governing bodies prior to July 1, 1978, or approved apprenticeship programs.
exams.quote: the applicant shall be required by Board regulations to take an oral or written examination to determine his general knowledge of the trade in which he desires licensure

interval_years.quote: A license for a tradesman shall be valid for three years from the date of issuance.

required.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require evidence of knowledge of code changes as a prerequisite to renewal of any certificate or license issued under this article.

available.quote: The regulatory boards may enter into agreements with other jurisdictions for the recognition of certificates and licenses issued by other jurisdictions.

requirements.value: The Board may enter into agreements with other jurisdictions for recognition of out-of-state licenses; universal license recognition is also available for individuals who have held a comparable license in another state for at least three years, passed required exams, and are in good standing.
requirements.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth

credential_type.quote: If the applicant successfully completes the examination, a license as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter, or natural gas fitter provider, or a certificate as a backflow prevention device worker, shall be issued.

is_mandatory.quote: Beginning July 1, 1995, no individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

title_protection.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice as a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider in the Commonwealth, except as provided for in this article, is prohibited and shall constitute the commission of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Beginning July 1, 1995, no individual shall engage in, or offer to engage in, work as a tradesman as defined in § 54.1-1128 unless he has been licensed under the provisions of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board shall have the power to require remedial education and to suspend, revoke or deny renewal of the certification or license of any individual who is found to be in violation of the statutes or regulations governing the practice of licensed tradesmen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a tradesman without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who finds that an individual is practicing as a tradesman, elevator mechanic, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider without a license as required by this article shall file a report to such effect with the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing incompetently as demonstrated by egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any building official who has reason to believe that (i) a tradesman, liquefied petroleum gas fitter or natural gas fitter provider is performing incompetently as demonstrated by an egregious or repeated violation of the Uniform Statewide Building Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring a license through fraud or other illegal means
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For any person to procure, or assist another to procure, through theft, fraud or other illegal means, a certificate, license or permit, from any state board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting without a license or without the proper class of license (contractor level)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting for, or bidding upon the construction, removal, repair or improvements to or upon real property owned, controlled or leased by another person without a license or certificate, or without the proper class of license as defined in § 54.1-1100 for the value of work to be performed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting or attempting to use the license or certificate of another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the Board in an application for license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving false or forged evidence of any kind to the Board or any member thereof in an application for the issuance or renewal of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another or using an expired or revoked license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license has been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Board may suspend, revoke, or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate, to any contractor who is shown to have a substantial identity of interest with a contractor whose license or certificate has been revoked or not renewed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of unemployment compensation or workers' compensation provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Board may suspend, revoke or deny renewal of an existing license or certificate, or refuse to issue a license or certificate to any contractor who violates the provisions of Chapter 5 (§ 60.2-500 et seq.) of Title 60.2 and Chapter 8 (§ 65.2-800 et seq.) of Title 65.2.

bonding_required.quote: In lieu of compliance with subsection B, an applicant may demonstrate financial responsibility by electing to obtain and maintain a bond in the amount of $50,000.

definition_quote.value: "Tradesman" means any individual who engages in, or offers to engage in, work for the general public for compensation in the trades of electrical, plumbing and heating, ventilation and air conditioning.
definition_quote.quote: "Tradesman" means any individual who engages in, or offers to engage in, work for the general public for compensation in the trades of electrical, plumbing and heating, ventilation and air conditioning.

license_tiers.quote: The Board may grant a Class A license in any of the following classifications: (i) residential building contractor, (ii) commercial building contractor, (iii) highway/heavy contractor, (iv) electrical contractor, (v) plumbing contractor, (vi) heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractor, (vii) fire sprinkler contractor, and (viii) specialty contractor.

scope_exclusions.quote: The provisions of this article shall not apply to any individual who is performing work on (i) any ship, boat, barge or other floating vessel or (ii) a single-family residence where the value of the work performed is less than $250 and such individual does not hold himself out to the general public as a tradesman.

qualifier_required.quote: The Board shall require a master tradesmen license as a condition of licensure for electrical, plumbing, and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractors.
